description.value: Bordertown Cider & Winery is a family-owned estate winery and cidery in the heart of Osoyoos, operated by the Gill family whose fifth-generation farming roots go deep in the South Okanagan. The winery produces 14 VQA-certified varietals from 100 acres of estate vineyards, including award-winning Cabernet Franc and Viognier, plus a craft hard apple cider pressed from their own orchard fruit. Visitors are welcomed into a Mission-style tasting room with no reservation required, making it an accessible stop on a wine-country cycling route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is accessible and confirms the winery is a real, operating business in Osoyoos, BC. Contact details (phone 1-250-495-3332, address 9140 92nd Avenue, Osoyoos, BC) match OSM tags exactly. The website makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities, so those fields remain null; the online wine store and bottle sales suggest retail takeout is possible but no food takeout is described.
concerns: Website header uses 'Bordertown Vineyards & Estate Winery' while the OSM name and website welcome heading both use 'Bordertown Cider & Winery' — the OSM name is supported by the site's own welcome text, so no correction needed, but the business operates under both names.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating estate winery and cidery with confirmed open status, public tasting room with no reservation required, and retail wine/cider sales — a natural stop on the Osoyoos wine-country cycling circuit.

wow_evidence: fifth-generation farming roots... 14 VQA-certified varietals from 100 acres of estate vineyards... no reservation required
